note: Proposed targets for the UI side of a frame, not yet agreed and not tied to a reference machine. Measure-UI.ps1 reports them; only -Strict turns a result over budget, or a budget without data, into a failure.

budgets.name: Frame build p95, preview frames with every tile cached

notes.long-html: A frame that brings a new tile into view draws it on the preview thread before it is shown (single-threaded raster), so frame build and input to frame p95 include those frames; the cached-tiles row shows the frames that drew none.
notes.preview-zoom: Every zoom step lays the document out again and draws the tiles in view on the preview thread, so each of its frames pays for that.
